DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed in the opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an answer on who decided and on what basis, and a written promise that nothing goes on his record.
What moved her: Nothing; offering that nothing goes on his record got her to write it down, but with no document behind it she did not give any ground.
What cost ground: Offering a rewrite straight away without answering her first questions, because it sounded like a finding had already been made that she had not been shown.
Try next time: After her first question, say who decided and own that the zero went in before you called her, then put one dated document of Owen's process in front of her before you mention a rewrite.
